svg.aria-label: One app, three surfaces: One Nuxt 4 app serves three surfaces: public site, page builder, admin dashboard. App shell: The same app is the shell for SDK apps. German and English: Prerendered pages in German and English. Dark mode follows the system. Accessible: Accessibility to WCAG 2.2 AA. Privacy: Consent per German GDPR law. Not yet: None of this runs yet. The rewrite is epic E4 Studio core
